groups.label: Pink main blooms
groups.blurb: Soft dusty-rose clusters forming the upper mass of the hanging wall.

items.role: Dusty-pink Austin roses as the rounded main flower clusters.
Pink phalaenopsis at the top-right with free-flowing petals.
Layered pink ranunculus enriching the flower surface.
Slim pink larkspur spikes adding vertical lines.
Fluffy pink hydrangea balls filling out the mass.

groups.label: White blooms & cascades
groups.blurb: Ivory whites with long cascading stems — the signature trailing soul of this design.

items.role: Long white larkspur cascading like a waterfall — the signature flower of this look.
Strings of white phalaenopsis through the middle section.
White hydrangea balls in the lower layer.
White ranunculus woven through to brighten the mass.
Fine white baby's-breath filling as light airy texture.

groups.label: Caramel & vintage tones
groups.blurb: Warm caramel and pale-brown notes bridging the cool pinks and whites.

items.role: Caramel-toned Austin roses giving the vintage warm transition.
Pale brown hydrangea balls for the dried-flower vintage feel.
Pale yellow reed lines adding fluffy wild texture.

groups.label: Greens & trailing lines
groups.blurb: Misty fine grass and thin vines stretching the trailing movement downward.

items.role: Misty fine fountain grass drooping downward.
Thin mountain-return vines stretching the trailing feel.
Grey-green eucalyptus pressing back the layers.
Fine hazy filler softening the whole arrangement.
